name: Lightning AI (formerly Grid.ai)
subcategory: ML training framework (PyTorch Lightning), AI development platform and, since 2026, GPU cloud
origin_detail: PyTorch Lightning began as William Falcon's research tool (started 2015 as a Columbia undergraduate; developed from 2018 at NYU's CILVR lab and Facebook AI Research during his PhD) and was open-sourced in 2019 (first release 2019-05-31). Falcon and Luis Capelo founded Grid.ai in 2019; it rebranded as Lightning AI on 2022-06-16 with a $40M Series B. In Jan 2026 it merged with GPU cloud Voltage Park (founded 2023, backed by the Navigation Fund) and kept the Lightning AI name.
openness_notes: Initial 2 (open core): PyTorch Lightning has been Apache-2.0 since its first LICENSE file (2019-08-05), and Grid.ai's revenue was to come from 'fully managed products' (TechCrunch, 2022). Current 2: the libraries (PyTorch Lightning, Fabric, TorchMetrics, LitGPT, LitServe, Thunder) remain Apache-2.0, never relicensed (the only substantive LICENSE edit, 2020-02-09, filled in the copyright line). The paid products, AI Studio (2023) and since 2026 an owned GPU cloud (36,000+ GPUs), are proprietary. After the Voltage Park merger the open code is a developer funnel for compute, so it trends toward 1, but the open libraries are still substantial.

exit_events.note: Merger completed and announced Jan 2026; the combined company operates as Lightning AI with William Falcon as CEO, Voltage Park's Ozan Kaya as President and Saurabh Giri as CPTO; 36,000+ owned GPUs (H100, B200, GB300). Structure, terms and valuation not disclosed.

risk_events: Slow software monetization: in Nov 2024, with $103M raised, the CEO projected only $10-20M ARR by end-2025
Jan 2026 merger turned a dev-tools company into a capital-intensive GPU owner-operator (36,000+ GPUs), exposed to GPU pricing and utilization
PyTorch Lightning is maintained by the company, not a foundation, so the project depends on Lightning AI's priorities
robustness: The libraries are Apache-2.0 with broad use (470M+ downloads cited by the company; 20M downloads and ~10,000 companies in production in 2022), so they could be forked and maintained by others. Governance is company-controlled. The company is now underpinned by owned compute and reports more than $500M ARR after the merger.
physical_science_relevance: PyTorch Lightning is widely used in academic ML research and was adopted as a reproducibility standard by NeurIPS 2019; it and Lightning Studios serve research groups training models on scientific data.
openness_effect_assessment: Openness made PyTorch Lightning a research standard (NeurIPS 2019 reproducibility challenge, 20M downloads by 2022, 470M+ by 2026), but selling tools on top of it grew slowly. About $103M was raised by Nov 2024, against a projected $10-20M ARR by end-2025. Scale came only from merging with a GPU owner: the combined company reports ARR rising from $18M (2024) to over $500M. The open framework is the funnel; compute is the business.
key_takeaway: Lightning AI shows that in the AI era an open-source training framework with a large research following did not support a large software business by itself. The company never relicensed; it reached scale by merging with GPU cloud Voltage Park (Jan 2026), which turned it into a compute provider with an open-source front end.
